description.value: Hon Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant located on Kingsway in Vancouver, a major east-west arterial with active cycling infrastructure. The restaurant offers indoor table service with air conditioning, making it a potential sit-down meal stop for cyclists travelling the Kingsway corridor. Card payments are accepted according to OSM data.
